record.name: Namibia
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Official NCRST and ministry announcements confirm the National Artificial Intelligence Institute launched on 23 September 2026. Its published remit covers local AI research, datasets, software, innovation and applications.

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The UNESCO readiness launch is co-produced with national authorities; a separately substantiated second institutional evidence origin was not established. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: Current primary launch announcements establish the institute and describe its local research and application remit. Together with individual English searches, which also cover an official language, these support medium confidence in the bounded none_identified finding. No mandate to evaluate advanced models was identified.

related_bodies.name: National Artificial Intelligence Institute
related_bodies.role: The ministry describes developing and testing local AI solutions. The institute was officially launched on 23 September 2026 and anchored at NCRST. It has centres for research and development, datasets, software development and AI innovation. The retrieved announcements do not establish a mandate to evaluate the safety of advanced models.

related_bodies.name: National Commission on Research, Science and Technology (NCRST)
related_bodies.role: It is reported to be developing the national AI strategy.

record.notes: NCRST says the institute was established in line with Cabinet Decision No. 14th/23.08.22/001 and is anchored at NCRST. The decision itself was not retrieved. The ministry describes developing and testing AI solutions for Namibia. These announcements establish a national general AI institute, but do not identify testing of general-purpose or frontier models for capabilities or behaviour risks. The finding is bounded by the retrieved evidence; it does not establish that no such mandate exists.

next_check.reason: Check whether an official mandate assigns the institute general-purpose or frontier model evaluation for capabilities or behaviour risks.
